selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Where did the traveler arrive in this passage?
questions.answer: He came to the school of Imam Rabbani, Ahmad Faruqi, who is described as the Renewer of the Second Millennium.

questions.question: What does the Imam say all Sufi paths should mainly produce?
questions.answer: They should mainly lead to the clear unveiling of faith’s truths.

questions.question: What did the Imam teach about belief and declaring Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: He taught that they are the base, core, light, and life of all human perfection.

questions.question: How does he compare stronger faith with visionary sweetness?
questions.answer: He says it is sweeter than many such experiences.

questions.question: Why are those foundations of faith so important in the passage?
questions.answer: They are presented as the key and basis for eternal happiness, everlasting life, and Paradise.

questions.question: What type of faith does the traveler say is not enough by itself?
questions.answer: Imitative faith is not enough by itself.

questions.question: What phrase is used as the means of opening the gate?
questions.answer: Bismillah, naming Allah as Merciful and Compassionate.

questions.question: What did he see when the Third Stopping-Place opened?
questions.answer: He saw it shining with four great and wide-reaching truths that clearly showed Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Who is the main teacher the traveler meets in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: Imam Rabbani, Ahmad Faruqi.

questions.question: What does the Imam present as the chief benefit of the Sufi paths?
questions.answer: He presents the clarification of belief-truths as their chief benefit.

questions.question: What prediction about a future scholar is mentioned?
questions.answer: A scholar from theology would appear and prove the truths of belief and Islam with reason and clarity.

questions.question: What four roles of belief and tawhid are named in relation to human perfection?
questions.answer: They are called its foundation, substance, light, and life.

questions.question: What does he say about its sweetness?
questions.answer: He says it is sweeter than many ecstatic visions.

questions.question: What response does the traveler say is necessary?
questions.answer: He says believers must reinforce faith and turn it into verified belief.

questions.question: What number is the next goal?
questions.answer: Thirty-three.

questions.question: What is special about the Third Stopping-Place once it appears?
questions.answer: It is full of wonders and shines with four great truths proving Divine unity.

questions.question: What title is given to Ahmad Faruqi in this passage?
questions.answer: He is called the Renewer of the Second Millennium.

questions.question: What did the Imam say is better than many miracles and spiritual visions?
questions.answer: Clearly understanding even one truth of faith is better.

questions.question: What kind of person had earlier scholars said would come?
questions.answer: A theologian who would prove the truths of Islam and belief through reason with complete clarity.

questions.question: What connection does the Imam make between belief and human excellence?
questions.answer: He says all human excellence stands on belief and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How carefully did the traveler listen to this lesson?
questions.answer: He listened with great attention.

questions.question: What does the traveler think is better than large amounts of gnosis?
questions.answer: Even an atom-like strengthening of faith.

questions.question: What lasting blessings are tied to the pillars of belief in this passage?
questions.answer: Eternal happiness, everlasting life, and Paradise.

questions.question: To what number did the traveler want to raise them?
questions.answer: He wanted to bring them to thirty-three.
